name: DLF The Arbour
summary: Existence, DLF as developer (promoter DLF Home Developers Ltd), Sector 63 / Golf Course Extension Road location, the HARERA number (RC/REP/HARERA/GGM/671/403/2023/15), 25 acres, 5 towers and 1,137 units are confirmed. Our possession year of 2028 conflicts with the RERA/portal date of March 2030. Our ₹11 Cr starting price is above Square Yards' ₹9.44 Cr and far above the ~₹7 Cr launch price, though it is close to current per-sq-ft resale rates.

checks.web: The Arbour by DLF at DLF Sixtythree, Sector 63; 1,137 homes sold out in 3 days in March 2023
DLF; promoter on registration: M/s DLF Home Developers Limited
checks.note: The registered promoter is the DLF subsidiary DLF Home Developers Limited. The developer label repeats the project name, which is cosmetic.

checks.ours: Sector 63, Golf Course Ext. Road, Sector 63, Gurugram, Haryana
checks.web: Sector 63 (village Maidawas), Golf Course Extension Road, Gurugram

checks.note: Same registration number. Ours omits the 'RC/REP/HARERA/' prefix, which is cosmetic.

checks.web: March 2030 (RERA completion per reratracker; Square Yards); 'expected by 2030' (broker pages)
checks.note: Our 2028 is about 2 years earlier than the RERA/portal date of March 2030. We found no source that supports 2028.

checks.web: ₹9.44 Cr (Square Yards; ₹27,250/sq ft asking); ₹8.49 Cr onwards (broker); launch ~₹7 Cr per unit (2023 news)
checks.note: Ours is ~16.5% above Square Yards' ₹9.44 Cr and ~30% above the ₹8.49 Cr broker figure. However, Square Yards' own ₹27,250/sq ft × ~3,950 sq ft ≈ ₹10.8 Cr, close to ours. Sources are internally inconsistent; the project is sold out, so all prices are resale. Severity is medium rather than high for that reason.

checks.web: 4 BHK (+ study + utility) only; ~3,900–3,950 sq ft
checks.note: Configuration matches. Size 3,965 sq ft is close to but not identical to the quoted 3,900 (Square Yards) / ~3,950 sq ft.
News coverage quoting DLF says 1,137 units. Square Yards' 1,338 appears to be an error.
